Name: Wallet Tools - Tractor Mod Addon
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] uses whatever currently held tool you have in order to do what it does. Unfortunately [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url] breaks that by removing them from the inventory meaning you are never actually holding the tool for tractor mod to see it.

This Addon fixes that by telling [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] to recognize a specific tool. 

While riding the tractor you will see a visual indicator at the top or your screen showing you what tool you have selected. You can cycle through them with Q and E (configurable) and on the empty slot it will default back to your held inventory item. This allows you to use the default behavior of the tractor for the rest of the mods normal features. 

You can also change the position of the tool indicator as well. 

If you want [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] support install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47465]Wallet Tools - Animal Husbandry Addon[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47825]Road Kill[/url]

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
